subject: Film & Cinema
title: German Expressionism: Madness on Screen
description: A short lesson to help you apply German Expressionism: Madness on Screen.

hook.text: Post-WWI Germany was broken. Its filmmakers turned that brokenness into visual style.

buildup.text: Jagged sets, exaggerated shadows, and distorted angles made the world feel unhinged.

discovery.text: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari became the movement's manifesto — reality itself was unreliable.

twist.text: When the Nazis took power, Expressionist filmmakers fled and transplanted their style to Hollywood.

climax.text: Horror, film noir, and gothic cinema all trace their DNA to German Expressionism.

punchline.text: A nation's trauma became cinema's style.

quiz.question: Where did German Expressionism's influence end up after the 1930s?
options: Hollywood genres like horror and film noir
